opening.argument: The presentation is an operational demonstration of a Scroll test environment and a Uniswap-style interface, not a concrete inducement to surrender funds or private information. The narration describes putting a wallet on a network test and placing the screen into TSUSDC, while the frames show swap and pool-interaction pages, including a notice reading "Intended for Demo Purposes Only." The displayed ETH and TSUSDC fields, pool listing, and pending interaction illustrate how the test interface operates. Nothing presented establishes a deceptive promise, an unusual payment request, or misappropriation of funds by the linked destination. The material therefore supports an educational technology demonstration, while the available evidence does not establish loss, harmful intent, or a deceptive outcome.
